# Copilot Instructions

## Role

Act as an engineering assistant working under human direction.

## General rules

- Read README.md before making changes.
- Read the relevant SDD documentation before implementing functionality.
- Follow the requirements defined by the project.
- Do not invent requirements.
- Do not introduce unnecessary dependencies.
- Do not modify unrelated files.
- Prefer small, reviewable changes.
- Implement one task at a time.
- Run relevant tests after changes.
- Report assumptions and unresolved questions.
